items.title: Earnings live updates: Datadog plunges 20% amid likely profit-taking, dragging on software stocks
items.summary: Earnings continue to be the market's engine, and a series of results this week from Palantir, SpaceX, and AMD are set to rev up stocks again.

items.title: Uber stock drops as bookings guidance disappoints; CEO bets on robotaxi push to grow overall business
items.summary: Uber reported second-quarter results on Wednesday that beat on bookings and profit, but shares fell as the ride-hailing giant's bookings guidance missed analyst projections. Uber says its robotaxi push is still well underway, with investments set to grow.

items.title: Is Wall Street Getting Uber Wrong? Bill Ackman Backs Bull Case That Robotaxi Fears Are Overblown
items.summary: Oguz Erkan, founder and writer of Capitalist-Letters, said the capital-intensive nature of robotaxi fleets makes large-scale platform operators like Uber well positioned to benefit as adoption grows.

items.title: Lucid Group (LCID) Starts $1.4 Billion Reset And Pushes Midsize EV To 2027
items.summary: Lucid Group (NasdaqGS:LCID) announced a US$1.4b cost saving plan as part of a broad operational reset. The company postponed its planned midsize EV launch to 2027 as it reshapes its product roadmap. Lucid Group created a new AI focused business unit to advance autonomous vehicle efforts with partners including Uber and Nuro. items.summary: On Aug. 5, 2026, the ride-hailing giant's profit outlook disappointed investors even as gross bookings surged 24% and revenue hit $14.2 billion.
